display_name: Two findings in the First Schedule of the Prohibition on Money Laundering Law, 5760-2000, recorded as typed values with their tests: the label (18ט) printed by two items on one day (a numbering collision), and item (18ו)'s citation of a section the consolidation prints as lapsed, with one sound control for each; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the person whose dealings in property the Law prohibits, whose conduct is tested against the offences the First Schedule lists. The row asks no question from the seat because it records references and numbering.

source.note: both deposits are excerpts of unofficial consolidations; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ and official/ with their page images.

not_deposited.note: the file holds the whole amendment of another Law, outside the row's scope; only the cropped image of p. 985 is deposited; tools/pdfcheck.py checks its four quotation lines only when SH3571_PDF names a copy as downloaded

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of two defects, each stating what the printed words need. Defect 1: the label (18ט) names two items on 1 March 2028 (the order in Kovetz HaTakanot 12422 p. 2196א for two years from the Wikisource editor's reading of its start, and the item added by s 27 of Sefer HaChukim 3571 p. 985 from 27 January 2028 as enacted, no postponement order looked for). Defect 2: item (18ו) cites s 7ג(ב) of the Infiltration Law as brought in by s 1(1) of the 2013 temporary law; the consolidation prints the section as lapsed (CONSOLIDATION-ONLY) and the day the period ended was not established, so the second assertion fails with NOTHING

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images named in NOTES.md were looked at by the builder
